thread:
maria_finance: Heads up — AcmeHealth disputed Q1 invoice INV-67890. They claim the platform fee jumped after the migration amendment and want an explanation. Can someone pull the invoice lines?

sam_sales: Got their note and forwarded. Their message says the platform fee changed from a % to a flat amount during the migration addendum. No contract page attached.

oliver_custsuccess: I spoke with their ops contact. Their expectation was the original 10% during the 90-day migration window. Billing-bot: Invoice INV-67890 created; amount_due: $128,450; lines: ["Committed GPU: $100,000", "Platform fee: $24,000", "Support - Premier: $4,450"].

maria_finance: Which pricing rule produced $24k? @tara_revenueops any signed amendment that sets a flat $12k/mo (we're seeing $24k this period because of billing frequency)?

tara_revenueops: Pulling docs. There's an amendment AMND-3321 that refers to "Schedule B (platform fee)". The scanned package is missing Schedule B. There's an email where product ops drafted: "Platform fee: flat USD 12,000 per month for 6 months" but that page isn't signed.

sam_sales: Sales copy had a template placeholder {PLATFORM_FEE}. Looks like someone pasted the draft flat fee text but it never got legally executed. We shouldn't have applied it.

maria_finance: OK — we need to stop collections and avoid escalation. Proposed actions: 1) set invoice to on-hold for dispute, 2) create a provisional credit if customer requests, 3) confirm the contract-authoritative value.

oliver_custsuccess: Acme wants the overcharge reversed immediately; they offered to sign the fixed fee going forward if we correct now.

tara_revenueops: Quick timeline: amendment signed by the customer but the Schedule B page with the flat fee wasn't initialed by legal or the customer on that page. Legal flagged it as unsigned.

maria_finance: Legal unsigned means non-binding. Per our billing policy fallback -> master SOW. Master SOW uses platform fee = 10% of committed spend. For the committed amount on this invoice that's $10,000.

billing-bot: Calc:
```
committed = 100000
pct = 0.10
expected_platform_fee = committed * pct  # $10,000
overcharge = 24000 - expected_platform_fee  # $14,000
```

sam_sales: Customer confirmed they'd accept reverting to 10% for this invoice if we issue a credit for the difference and update the docs before next billing. They'll sign the amendment if sales sends the final executed copy.

maria_finance: I'll prepare credit memo for $14,000 and update invoice to INV-67890-C1. Question: credits >$10k need dual approval per policy — @tara_revenueops will route to CFO/legal?

tara_revenueops: I'll route the approval. Also legal wants a note in the file that the unsigned Schedule B is not enforceable. Sales should capture signed Schedule B if flat fee is desired.

oliver_custsuccess: I'll notify AcmeHealth that we've placed INV-67890 on hold and that a credit is in process; give them ETA 48 hours.

maria_finance: Created credit memo CM-3344 for $14,000 and set invoice status to On Hold (Billing Dispute). Holding dunning until approval completes.

sam_sales: I'll ping Acme CFO to confirm acceptance of the corrected invoice and attach the draft amendment for signature.

billing-bot: Reminder: update AR ledger and flag potential revenue recognition impact for the finance close.

maria_finance: Noted — we'll coordinate with RevRec if needed. Leaving thread open until legal signs off on the unsigned schedule status.

tara_revenueops: Legal confirmed: Schedule B was not executed, not binding. Approvals complete. Proceed with credit and close dispute. Sales to re-execute if they want a flat fee.

maria_finance: Marking collection status to Resolved. Will monitor for any downstream adjustments and confirm with RevRec.

oliver_custsuccess: Customer acknowledged and said thanks for the quick fix. Closing on our side. :white_check_mark:
